regions.merged_text: -perpetual member Feast of the Apparaition of our Bl. Imaculate Mary. - Febr. 11th - 1947 God bless you Br. Pat. Offer all to Jesus - Who has suffered so much for us all - for you and me. My Jesus - Thy will be done. Forgive us our sins. Deliver us from the flames of Hell. Have mercy on the souls in Purgatory - Especially the most abandoned. Don't worry Pat. Rather foster confidence in God's mercy by thanking Him for every thin - even ahead of time - Please pray for me -
